Usage: py_click.py [OPTIONS] [PATH]

  click probe. Mentions --force in prose and --dry-run at the start of a
  wrapped line.

Options:
  -f, --force              skip confirmation prompts
  -n, --limit INTEGER      maximum number of results to return, a deliberately
                           long description so that click has to wrap it onto
                           continuation lines
  --dry-run                print what would change
  -v, --verbose            increase verbosity
  -o, --output PATH        write output here
  -cd, --print-config-dir  multi-letter single-dash alias
  -no-color                single-dash word option
  --color / --no-color2    boolean pair
  --help                   Show this message and exit.
